name.en: Fio Puro Black Merino Roll-Neck Sweater with a Folded Collar, Close Fit and Long Sleeves

description.en: A black merino roll-neck, folded once at the collar and close through the arm. It layers under a jacket without bunching.
description.pt-BR: Gola rolê preta de merino, dobrada uma vez, justa na manga. Entra sob uma jaqueta sem embaraçar.
